contractList.title: Contracts
contractList.intro: The organiser's 100 sample contracts plus demo contracts. A contract's status summarises the evaluation of each payment milestone.

filters.searchPlaceholder: Search code, title, buyer or supplier

waiting.draft: Complete the file and digitise the terms

modal.cancelBody: Cancel the signing of {{code}} and return it to draft. Only possible while nobody has signed; the action is logged.
modal.cancelled: Signing cancelled; the contract is a draft again

contractUpload.title: Register a new contract

positionsNotice.title: Signature positions are assigned in the next step
positionsNotice.body: Positions are not detected automatically. Next, you place one slot on the PDF page for each signer, in the order above.
positionsNotice.compact: Next: place signing fields on the document.

file.label: Contract file
file.constraint: PDF or DOCX, up to 20 MB
file.replaceHint: Replacing the file after configuration forces a new check of the signature positions and the digitized copy, so that no signature lands in the wrong place.

errors.type: Only PDF or DOCX files are accepted.
errors.size: The file is larger than 20 MB.

appendix.label: Attached appendices
appendix.drop: Drag and drop or choose appendix files
appendix.invalid: Use non-empty PDF/DOCX files, up to 20 MB per file and 20 appendices.

signers.label: Signers and signing order
signers.hint: One to four signers. A single signature completes the workflow; two or more signers must represent both parties. Sign in order; the final step requires digital signing.

errors.count: One to four signers are required.
errors.missing: Pick a person for every step.
errors.bothSides: With two or more signers, both buyer and supplier must be represented.

signers.singleNotice: Single-signer workflow: the contract becomes effective after this person signs digitally. The contract editor explicitly chooses this workflow.
signers.compactHint: Sign in order from top to bottom; the last signer uses a digital signature.

errors.INVALID_VALUE: The value must be positive with at most two decimals.
errors.INVALID_DATES: The start date must not be after the end date.
errors.INVALID_SUPPLIER: Pick a supplier from the list.
errors.SIGNER_COUNT: One to four signers are required.
errors.INVALID_SIGNER: Signers must belong to their side and not repeat.
errors.SIGNERS_BOTH_SIDES: With two or more signers, both buyer and supplier must be represented.
errors.INVALID_REVIEWER: The reviewer must be a buyer contract officer.
errors.DRAFT_LOCKED: The terms are locked; cancel the signing to edit.
errors.INVALID_CODE: The contract code changed; reload the page.
errors.BUYER_EDITORS_ONLY: Only buyer contract officers and owners can create a file.
errors.UNKNOWN: The file could not be saved.

placeholders.title: e.g. Supply equipment for the practice lab

form.ruleVersion: Pinned rule version: {{id}}. Later configuration changes do not replace this draft’s version.

checks.title: Current file and configuration

unsigned.title: No digital signature yet
unsigned.detail: in the file: expected for a new contract.

checks.local: File changes not yet saved to server
checks.pendingVerification: This is file metadata and configuration only. Content, terms and signatures are checked in later steps.

preview.title: Preview
preview.schematic: Illustration of signature areas; this is not a rendering of the selected file.
preview.selectFile: Select a file or generate a sample to preview the actual document.
preview.unavailable: The document could not be rendered. Check the file or download it to open in your editor.
preview.noStoredFile: No original file has been stored. The organiser dataset does not include contract files.
preview.completeForm: Complete the terms and select signers to see the automatically updated draft PDF.
preview.unsaved: This draft PDF follows the form and has not been saved. Generate and use the sample to select it as the signing document.
preview.fileBasis: This file is the signing document. Form changes do not modify it; regenerate the sample or upload the revised file.

contractUpload.intro: Step 1/5. A new contract is split into milestones by the workflow of its type and evaluated with the same payment rules as the sample contracts.

sample.notice: Generate a real DOCX using the current terms and 1–4 signers. Download, edit and upload it again; it is marked as an unsigned test fixture.
sample.compactNotice: Create a DOCX with the current content and signers.

templates.notice: Administrators manage templates. Adjust signers and terms for this draft without changing the source template.
templates.bodyHint: Variables: title, buyer, supplier, valueMillion, startDate, endDate; enclose in double braces. Leave blank for default content.
templates.stale: Terms or signers changed after generation. Regenerate the document before saving.
templates.bodyEmptyHint: Leave blank to use the default content.

demo.title: Equipment supply agreement — demo
demo.body: Sample terms for testing: {{supplier}} supplies equipment to {{buyer}} under {{title}}. The parties review delivery evidence before processing payment.
